subject: general
question: Amongst six friends G, H, I, J, K and L, each has a different height. G is taller than only two other friends. I is shorter than only one friend. K is shorter than G but taller than J. H is shorter than L. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Six friends G, H, I, J, K, and L are comparing their heights.

1) G is taller than only two other friends. I is shorter than only one friend.

__ > I > __ > G > __ > __

2) K is shorter than G but taller than J.

__ > I > __ > G > K > J

3) H is shorter than L.

L > I > H > G > K > J

Therefore, the shortest among all the friends is J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"**Option 2".
